source_pack.title: House of the Dragon Season 3 Finale Legacy Catalog

signature_beats.name: Caraxes Sortie
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon mounts Caraxes and deliberately enters an active combat, pursuit, or interception scene.
signature_beats.pitch: The Blood Wyrm is still Daemon's most reliable argument.

signature_beats.name: Makes Peace
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon and Rhaenyra explicitly reconcile, forgive one another, or reaffirm that they are acting together.
signature_beats.pitch: The terrifying power couple gets functional again.

signature_beats.name: Defies the Queen
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon knowingly disobeys or circumvents a direct instruction from Rhaenyra.
signature_beats.pitch: Or he remembers that obedience has never been his brand.

signature_beats.name: Protects Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon takes a concrete action that shields Rhaena from punishment, capture, or immediate physical danger.
signature_beats.pitch: The murder prince scores through dad mode.

signature_beats.name: Hands Her Over
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon voluntarily surrenders Rhaena to Rhaenyra's custody or supports a punishment Rhaenyra imposes on her.
signature_beats.pitch: The brutal branch: crown over daughter.

signature_beats.name: Baela Heart-to-Heart
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon and Baela have a private conversation in which either one directly discusses Jace, Rhaena, or their family relationship.
signature_beats.pitch: One real father-daughter scene would suddenly matter a lot.

signature_beats.name: Faces Aemond
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daemon and Aemond directly see, address, or attack one another in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: Two of the show's most dangerous men finally share the same problem.

signature_beats.name: Orders Dragonfire
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra explicitly orders a dragon or dragonrider to burn an enemy, force, fortification, or named target.
signature_beats.pitch: The queen stops managing the crisis and chooses fire.

signature_beats.name: Makes Peace
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra and Daemon explicitly reconcile, forgive one another, or reaffirm that they are acting together.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting the royal marriage survives its latest civil war.

signature_beats.name: Punishes Daemon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra orders Daemon confined, stripped of authority, arrested, or otherwise formally punished.
signature_beats.pitch: The marriage becomes a constitutional crisis.

signature_beats.name: Sapphic Spark
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra and Mysaria share an unmistakably romantic or sexual interaction in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The politics stop for one very specific kind of diplomacy.

signature_beats.name: Pushes Mysaria Away
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra explicitly rejects Mysaria's intimacy, removes her from confidence, or tells her their relationship cannot continue.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting the favorite adviser becomes the favorite scapegoat.

signature_beats.name: Protects Helaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra takes a concrete action to protect Helaena or Jaehaera from another character's threat or demand.
signature_beats.pitch: The claimant becomes protector of the rival queen's family.

signature_beats.name: Punishes Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra imposes or orders a concrete punishment on Rhaena for Sheepstealer, Jace, or disobedience.
signature_beats.pitch: Family grief finally turns into royal discipline.

signature_beats.name: Cryptic Warning
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena says a clearly prophetic or ominous line about something that has not yet happened in the episode.
signature_beats.pitch: One strange sentence can become the whole night's clue.

signature_beats.name: Protects Jaehaera
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena takes a concrete action to hide, move, defend, or secure Jaehaera from a perceived threat.
signature_beats.pitch: Her agency pays when she chooses her daughter over everybody's plans.

signature_beats.name: Leaves With Alicent
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena voluntarily leaves Black custody with Alicent or agrees on screen to escape with her.
signature_beats.pitch: Mother and daughter finally choose flight together.

signature_beats.name: Refuses to Run
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena directly refuses Alicent or another rescuer's request that she flee King's Landing.
signature_beats.pitch: Her agency can also mean staying exactly where everyone wants her gone.

signature_beats.name: Dreamfyre in Flesh
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena physically approaches, touches, mounts, or otherwise interacts with the real Dreamfyre in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The vision becomes real.

signature_beats.name: Refuses Dreamfyre
signature_beats.trigger_text: Someone urges Helaena to use or ride Dreamfyre and Helaena explicitly refuses.
signature_beats.pitch: She can score by rejecting dragon power just as clearly as embracing it.

signature_beats.name: Warns Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger_text: Helaena directly gives Rhaenyra a prophetic warning, prediction, or cryptic statement about danger to come.
signature_beats.pitch: The rival queen becomes the audience for the realm's strangest weather report.

signature_beats.name: Moondancer Sortie
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela mounts Moondancer and flies on an active mission, pursuit, reconnaissance, or battle sortie.
signature_beats.pitch: The dragonrider actually gets deployed.

signature_beats.name: Comforts Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela explicitly comforts, defends, or reassures Rhaena over Sheepstealer or Jace.
signature_beats.pitch: Sister solidarity pays.

signature_beats.name: Calls Out Rhaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela directly criticizes Rhaena for Sheepstealer, Jace, or a dangerous choice she made.
signature_beats.pitch: Or sister solidarity finally reaches its limit.

signature_beats.name: Kisses Alyn Again
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela and Alyn share another unmistakably romantic kiss.
signature_beats.pitch: The Velaryon romance survives the war for at least one scene.

signature_beats.name: Ends It With Alyn
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela explicitly rejects, ends, or walks back her romantic relationship with Alyn.
signature_beats.pitch: You are betting on war beating romance.

signature_beats.name: Challenges Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger_text: Baela directly challenges or refuses a decision by Rhaenyra involving Rhaena, Alyn, or the Velaryons.
signature_beats.pitch: She stops being only a loyal niece and pushes back.

signature_beats.name: Intel Pays Off
signature_beats.trigger_text: Mysaria gives specific intelligence that directly causes Rhaenyra or another Black leader to change a plan or take action.
signature_beats.pitch: The spy network earns its screen time.

signature_beats.name: Sapphic Spark
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra and Mysaria share an unmistakably romantic or sexual interaction in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The romance keeps moving.

signature_beats.name: Queen Pushes Away
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaenyra explicitly rejects Mysaria's intimacy, removes her from confidence, or tells her their relationship cannot continue.
signature_beats.pitch: The adviser becomes the scapegoat.

signature_beats.name: Turns the Queen
signature_beats.trigger_text: Mysaria persuades Rhaenyra to take a course of action Rhaenyra was resisting earlier in the same scene.
signature_beats.pitch: Pillow talk becomes policy.

signature_beats.name: Mysaria Exposed
signature_beats.trigger_text: A named character gives Rhaenyra concrete evidence that Mysaria concealed, manipulated, or misrepresented something important.
signature_beats.pitch: Influence becomes evidence against her.

signature_beats.name: Challenges Daemon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Mysaria directly opposes, threatens, or undermines Daemon in a conversation with him or in Rhaenyra's presence.
signature_beats.pitch: The queen's two most dangerous confidants collide.

signature_beats.name: Rhaena Cries
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena visibly cries or breaks down emotionally on screen.
signature_beats.pitch: Petty, clear, and extremely live-watchable.

signature_beats.name: Sheepstealer Returns
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena physically reunites with Sheepstealer and the dragon allows her to approach or remain near him.
signature_beats.pitch: The feral boyfriend takes her back.

signature_beats.name: Sheepstealer Rejects
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena tries to approach or command Sheepstealer and the dragon visibly avoids, ignores, or threatens her.
signature_beats.pitch: The people's dragon has boundaries.

signature_beats.name: Rhaena Redeems
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena takes a deliberate action that directly saves a named ally from serious danger.
signature_beats.pitch: One heroic choice could erase a lot of yelling at the television.

signature_beats.name: Bad Idea Again
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena knowingly makes a choice that immediately creates a new danger or materially worsens an existing crisis.
signature_beats.pitch: One last 'RHAENA, WHY?'

signature_beats.name: Confronts Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger_text: Rhaena directly argues with Rhaenyra about Sheepstealer, Jace, punishment, or her right to make her own choices.
signature_beats.pitch: The child finally argues back at the queen.

signature_beats.name: Royal Treatment
signature_beats.trigger_text: Orwyle personally examines, treats, or prescribes medicine for Helaena, Jaehaera, Rhaenyra, or another named royal.
signature_beats.pitch: A tiny doctor scene gives the sleeper pick a real floor.

signature_beats.name: Smuggles Helaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Orwyle knowingly helps Helaena or Jaehaera escape, hide from, or bypass Black custody.
signature_beats.pitch: One quiet maester scene could swing the pick.

signature_beats.name: Exposes a Poison
signature_beats.trigger_text: Orwyle identifies or directly reveals that a named character has been poisoned or drugged.
signature_beats.pitch: The medical guy gets to solve the dangerous medical problem.

signature_beats.name: Helps Alicent
signature_beats.trigger_text: Orwyle knowingly gives Alicent information, medicine, or access that helps her evade or oppose Black authority.
signature_beats.pitch: Old court loyalties become a scoring event.

signature_beats.name: Defies Mysaria
signature_beats.trigger_text: Orwyle explicitly refuses, conceals information from, or works around an instruction from Mysaria.
signature_beats.pitch: The maester and the spymaster quietly disagree over who runs the castle.

signature_beats.name: Aemond Wakes
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aemond clearly regains consciousness and becomes mentally responsive after Alicent's poisoning.
signature_beats.pitch: The first sweat is simply whether he gets back in the game.

signature_beats.name: Calls Out Alicent
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aemond directly accuses or confronts Alicent about poisoning or betraying him.
signature_beats.pitch: The mother-son disaster finally becomes a conversation.

signature_beats.name: Forgives Alicent
signature_beats.trigger_text: After learning she poisoned him, Aemond explicitly forgives Alicent or refuses an opportunity to punish her.
signature_beats.pitch: The most shocking branch is mercy.

signature_beats.name: Finds Vhagar
signature_beats.trigger_text: A conscious Aemond physically reunites with Vhagar in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: One eye plus one enormous dragon means power is restored.

signature_beats.name: Chooses Alys
signature_beats.trigger_text: A conscious Aemond explicitly chooses to remain with, trust, or follow Alys instead of immediately leaving Harrenhal.
signature_beats.pitch: The Harrenhal relationship beats the war for one more scene.

signature_beats.name: Rejects Alys
signature_beats.trigger_text: A conscious Aemond explicitly rejects Alys's advice, protection, or intimacy and chooses to leave her behind.
signature_beats.pitch: The spell breaks.

signature_beats.name: Targets Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aemond explicitly makes finding, killing, capturing, or taking revenge on Aegon an immediate objective.
signature_beats.pitch: Sibling rivalry becomes strategic priority.

signature_beats.name: Protects Helaena
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent takes a concrete action intended to secure Helaena or Jaehaera's safety.
signature_beats.pitch: Whatever Alicent becomes, Helaena remains the motive.

signature_beats.name: Saves Aemond
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent actively seeks an antidote, healer, or other intervention intended to keep Aemond alive after poisoning him.
signature_beats.pitch: The assassin arc turns instantly into mother panic.

signature_beats.name: Leaves Him Dying
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent knowingly leaves an incapacitated Aemond without seeking help when she has a clear opportunity to do so.
signature_beats.pitch: She commits to the choice all the way.

signature_beats.name: Returns to Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent voluntarily returns to Rhaenyra's custody or presence to report what happened with Aemond.
signature_beats.pitch: She finishes the bargain she started.

signature_beats.name: Runs From the Deal
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent deliberately avoids returning to Rhaenyra and takes action to escape or hide from the Blacks instead.
signature_beats.pitch: She decides she has honored enough bargains for one lifetime.

signature_beats.name: Finds Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent and Aegon physically reunite and exchange dialogue in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The son she betrayed and the mother who lost control finally share a room.

signature_beats.name: Asks Helaena Forgive
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alicent explicitly asks Helaena to forgive her for a decision involving Helaena, Aemond, Aegon, or the war.
signature_beats.pitch: Maternal guilt finally gets said aloud.

signature_beats.name: Alys Witchcraft
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys performs or causes something the episode presents as supernatural, prophetic, impossible, or overtly magical.
signature_beats.pitch: If Harrenhal gets weird, you get paid.

signature_beats.name: Saves Aemond
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys actively treats, rescues, or otherwise prevents Aemond from dying from the poisoning or its immediate consequences.
signature_beats.pitch: He is now her most valuable patient.

signature_beats.name: Lets Poison Work
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys clearly realizes Aemond is poisoned and deliberately refuses or withholds help that she could provide.
signature_beats.pitch: The witch decides fate has spoken.

signature_beats.name: Uses the Eggs
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys physically moves, reveals, gives away, hides elsewhere, or invokes the hidden dragon eggs as part of a concrete plan.
signature_beats.pitch: The season's weirdest stash finally becomes actionable.

signature_beats.name: Keeps Eggs Hidden
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys is directly asked about dragons or eggs and knowingly conceals the hidden clutch.
signature_beats.pitch: The secret survives the finale intact.

signature_beats.name: Faces Alicent
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alys and Alicent directly confront one another about Aemond, the poisoning, or who controls what happens to him next.
signature_beats.pitch: Two very different women with claims on Aemond finally collide.

signature_beats.name: Aegon Sass
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon delivers an unmistakably sarcastic, cutting, morbidly funny, or self-aware line.
signature_beats.pitch: Your safest payout is that Aegon remains Aegon.

signature_beats.name: Flies Sunfyre
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon mounts Sunfyre and the two become airborne together in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The comeback becomes physical.

signature_beats.name: Stays Grounded
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon has a clear opportunity to flee or move with Sunfyre and explicitly chooses to remain on the ground.
signature_beats.pitch: The broken king chooses stubbornness over escape.

signature_beats.name: Claims the Throne
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon explicitly makes retaking the Iron Throne or being recognized as king his immediate objective.
signature_beats.pitch: The political branch: crown first.

signature_beats.name: Chooses Aemond
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon explicitly makes finding, killing, or taking revenge on Aemond his immediate priority over Rhaenyra or the throne.
signature_beats.pitch: The personal branch: brother first.

signature_beats.name: Trusts Tyland
signature_beats.trigger_text: Aegon accepts and follows a consequential plan proposed by Tyland after Tyland explains the plan to him.
signature_beats.pitch: The king finally takes advice from the unexpectedly competent Lannister.

signature_beats.name: Takes Larys Back
signature_beats.trigger_text: After Larys's episode-7 departure, Aegon physically reunites with him and explicitly accepts his help or counsel again.
signature_beats.pitch: The strangest buddy relationship gets renewed.

signature_beats.name: New Escape Plan
signature_beats.trigger_text: Larys proposes or executes a specific plan to evade capture, pursuit, or political danger.
signature_beats.pitch: He treats catastrophe like a logistics problem.

signature_beats.name: Rejoins Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: After leaving him in episode 7, Larys physically reunites with Aegon and exchanges dialogue with him.
signature_beats.pitch: The weirdest buddy comedy gets an encore.

signature_beats.name: Sells Out Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Larys deliberately gives an enemy information or assistance that materially harms Aegon's position.
signature_beats.pitch: Self-preservation beats loyalty.

signature_beats.name: Warns Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Larys gives Aegon specific intelligence about an immediate threat and Aegon acts on the warning.
signature_beats.pitch: Spymaster as guardian angel, somehow.

signature_beats.name: Deals With Enemy
signature_beats.trigger_text: Larys knowingly bargains with a Black or Hightower-aligned opponent for his own safety or advancement.
signature_beats.pitch: The free agent starts shopping himself around.

signature_beats.name: Pressures Tyland
signature_beats.trigger_text: Larys directly pressures, threatens, or manipulates Tyland over Aegon's plans or the missing treasury.
signature_beats.pitch: The two surviving schemers start negotiating with each other.

signature_beats.name: Lannister Plan
signature_beats.trigger_text: A plan proposed by Tyland directly gets him and/or Aegon out of an immediate danger.
signature_beats.pitch: The supporting character gets to be the competent one.

signature_beats.name: Risks It for Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Tyland knowingly puts himself in immediate physical danger to protect Aegon or buy him time.
signature_beats.pitch: The surprisingly loyal branch.

signature_beats.name: Leaves Aegon
signature_beats.trigger_text: Tyland deliberately abandons Aegon during an immediate danger when he has a clear opportunity to stay.
signature_beats.pitch: The survival branch: very Lannister, just not very heroic.

signature_beats.name: Gold Secret Spills
signature_beats.trigger_text: Tyland reveals, uses, bargains with, or gives a concrete clue to the location of the missing royal treasury.
signature_beats.pitch: The money mystery finally becomes leverage.

signature_beats.name: Confronts Larys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Tyland directly challenges, refuses, or accuses Larys over Aegon's safety, a plan, or hidden information.
signature_beats.pitch: The two surviving schemers finally stop politely sharing a wagon.

signature_beats.name: Tessarion Sortie
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron mounts Tessarion and flies into an active mission, interception, or battle.
signature_beats.pitch: The prince gets to actually be a dragon prince.

signature_beats.name: Defies Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron directly refuses, reverses, or undermines an instruction or political demand from Ormund.
signature_beats.pitch: The puppet cuts a string.

signature_beats.name: Obeys Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron reluctantly carries out a clearly stated order from Ormund that he initially resists or dislikes.
signature_beats.pitch: Or the grooming works one more time.

signature_beats.name: Rejects a Crown
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron is hailed, proposed, or treated as king and explicitly rejects the claim.
signature_beats.pitch: He refuses the most dangerous promotion imaginable.

signature_beats.name: Accepts Royal Claim
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron explicitly accepts being proclaimed, styled, or advanced as a king or replacement claimant.
signature_beats.pitch: The nice prince takes the poisoned crown.

signature_beats.name: Protects Gwayne
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron takes a concrete action that directly protects or rescues Gwayne from immediate danger.
signature_beats.pitch: The nephew returns the loyalty.

signature_beats.name: Springs a Trap
signature_beats.trigger_text: Ormund reveals or executes a deception, ambush, planted agent, or prearranged scheme against an opposing force or named character.
signature_beats.pitch: He has spent the season looking annoyingly prepared.

signature_beats.name: Keeps Ulf
signature_beats.trigger_text: Ulf follows a consequential order from Ormund that directly harms or obstructs the Blacks.
signature_beats.pitch: The recruitment pays off.

signature_beats.name: Ulf Turns on Him
signature_beats.trigger_text: Ulf directly betrays, attacks, refuses, or exposes Ormund after previously agreeing to work with him.
signature_beats.pitch: Or Ormund discovers the downside of trusting Ulf.

signature_beats.name: Controls Daeron
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron carries out a consequential political or military action after Ormund explicitly pressures or orders him to do it.
signature_beats.pitch: The puppet-master gets another win.

signature_beats.name: Daeron Humbles Him
signature_beats.trigger_text: Daeron directly rejects Ormund in a way that costs Ormund authority, face, or control in front of others.
signature_beats.pitch: The boy finally embarrasses his handler.

signature_beats.name: Threatens Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Ormund explicitly threatens Corlys's life or body to force a Velaryon or Black character to act.
signature_beats.pitch: His hostage becomes a political weapon.

signature_beats.name: Protects Daeron
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne physically intervenes, gives up an advantage, or defies another person to protect Daeron from immediate danger.
signature_beats.pitch: Uncle mode is his clearest finale identity.

signature_beats.name: Defies Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne directly refuses or undermines an order or scheme from Ormund.
signature_beats.pitch: The Hightower family argument becomes policy.

signature_beats.name: Backs Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne explicitly sides with Ormund against Daeron in a disputed decision.
signature_beats.pitch: Family hierarchy wins over affection.

signature_beats.name: Joins the Attack
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne leaves a defensive position to personally join an organized attack or sortie.
signature_beats.pitch: The knight chooses the field.

signature_beats.name: Stays With Daeron
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne deliberately remains with Daeron instead of joining an available battle or pursuit.
signature_beats.pitch: The guardian chooses the boy over glory.

signature_beats.name: Criston Tribute
signature_beats.trigger_text: Gwayne explicitly honors, mourns, defends, or invokes Criston Cole's memory in a present-tense decision.
signature_beats.pitch: A dead commander still has a hold on him.

signature_beats.name: Guards Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Jon is visibly assigned to, escorting, or personally guarding Corlys as a captive.
signature_beats.pitch: Even a minor villain needs a floor, and Corlys is his ticket.

signature_beats.name: Hurts Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Jon personally wounds, mutilates, or tortures Corlys on screen.
signature_beats.pitch: The nasty branch: the hostage situation gets worse.

signature_beats.name: Frees Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Jon deliberately releases or helps Corlys escape against Ormund's interests.
signature_beats.pitch: The wildest redemption swing on the character board.

signature_beats.name: Obeys Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Jon carries out a consequential direct order from Ormund in the finale.
signature_beats.pitch: The loyal henchman stays useful.

signature_beats.name: Refuses Ormund
signature_beats.trigger_text: Jon openly refuses a direct order from Ormund or abandons an assigned Hightower task.
signature_beats.pitch: Or the hired sword remembers he is not actually a Hightower.

signature_beats.name: Rejects His Captor
signature_beats.trigger_text: Corlys directly refuses a demand, bargain, oath, or threat made by Ormund or Jon Roxton.
signature_beats.pitch: Missing finger, intact spine.

signature_beats.name: Escape Attempt
signature_beats.trigger_text: Corlys personally attempts to escape his captivity, whether or not the attempt succeeds.
signature_beats.pitch: The Sea Snake tries to solve his own problem.

signature_beats.name: Takes a Deal
signature_beats.trigger_text: Corlys knowingly accepts a bargain or concession demanded by his captors in exchange for safety or another person's protection.
signature_beats.pitch: Survival requires swallowing his pride.

signature_beats.name: Reconciles With Alyn
signature_beats.trigger_text: Corlys explicitly apologizes to Alyn or the two reach a clear father-son reconciliation.
signature_beats.pitch: The emotional rescue payoff.

signature_beats.name: Clashes With Alyn
signature_beats.trigger_text: After reuniting or communicating, Corlys and Alyn directly argue about fatherhood, legitimacy, or Corlys's past treatment of his sons.
signature_beats.pitch: Rescue immediately becomes family therapy.

signature_beats.name: Names His Sons
signature_beats.trigger_text: Corlys publicly or directly acknowledges both Alyn and Addam as his sons in front of another named character.
signature_beats.pitch: The family secret finally becomes a family statement.

signature_beats.name: Seasmoke Sortie
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam mounts Seasmoke and flies into an active mission, pursuit, or battle.
signature_beats.pitch: The reliable rider gets deployed.

signature_beats.name: Obeys Rhaenyra
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam follows a consequential direct order from Rhaenyra even though it conflicts with Alyn, Corlys, or Baela's wishes.
signature_beats.pitch: Crown over family.

signature_beats.name: Chooses Family
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam knowingly refuses or alters a direct Black order because it would endanger Alyn, Corlys, or Baela.
signature_beats.pitch: Family over crown.

signature_beats.name: Backs Alyn
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam takes a concrete action supporting Alyn's plan concerning Corlys's captivity or Velaryon command.
signature_beats.pitch: Brotherhood wins the triangle.

signature_beats.name: Confesses to Baela
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam explicitly tells Baela he has romantic feelings for her or directly asks her to choose him romantically.
signature_beats.pitch: The awkward romantic tension finally says the quiet part aloud.

signature_beats.name: Confronts Ulf
signature_beats.trigger_text: Addam directly confronts, threatens, or attacks Ulf after learning of Ulf's cooperation with Ormund.
signature_beats.pitch: The loyal dragonseed gets a traitor to judge.

signature_beats.name: Takes Command
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn gives a military or naval order that is visibly obeyed by Velaryon soldiers, sailors, or ships.
signature_beats.pitch: He has become the working heir whether anyone says it or not.

signature_beats.name: Rescue Attempt
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn personally launches or joins an operation whose explicit purpose is rescuing Corlys.
signature_beats.pitch: The severed-finger message gets answered with action.

signature_beats.name: Stands Down
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn abandons or delays a military action because Corlys's captors threaten Corlys's life.
signature_beats.pitch: The hostage actually works.

signature_beats.name: Forgives Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn explicitly accepts an apology from Corlys or tells Corlys he forgives him.
signature_beats.pitch: The family-healing branch.

signature_beats.name: Calls Out Corlys
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn directly confronts Corlys about fatherhood, legitimacy, or neglect after they communicate or reunite.
signature_beats.pitch: The far more combustible branch.

signature_beats.name: Kisses Baela
signature_beats.trigger_text: Alyn and Baela share an unmistakably romantic kiss in the present timeline.
signature_beats.pitch: The rescue plot is not the only thing he has going on.

signature_beats.name: Vermithor Sortie
signature_beats.trigger_text: Hugh mounts Vermithor and enters an active mission or battle.
signature_beats.pitch: You drafted the Bronze Fury; use the Bronze Fury.

signature_beats.name: Kat Over Crown
signature_beats.trigger_text: Hugh knowingly rejects or abandons a military instruction because Kat's immediate safety takes priority.
signature_beats.pitch: Marriage beats war.
